create.filterText: Snapchat-style: your scene sticks to the face (forehead, nose, chin…) and reacts to expressions. Selfie camera.
create.lead: Either way, your 3D comes from Spline (Export → Code) and you get a link + a QR code to share.
create.museumText: One or more posters. The phone aiming at a poster sees its 3D scene come out. Rear camera.
create.title: What do you want to create?

editor.backHelp: The AR “Quit” button will go to this link, for example your ProtoPie Cloud prototype (it reopens in ProtoPie Player if the app is installed).
editor.copyManually: Select the link and copy it.
editor.sceneHelp: In Spline: Export → Code, copy the URL ending in scene.splinecode. A .glb link works too.

editor.lead: Your Spline scene sticks to a point of the face and follows the head, like a Snapchat filter. No image to upload.
editor.pageTitle: Spline AR — Create a face filter
editor.reactHelp: In Spline, create a boolean variable with one of these names, then a “Variable Change” event that starts your animation or sound. It turns true during the expression.
editor.reactTitle: Make the scene react to the face
editor.sceneTip: Model your object facing the camera (front towards +Z), top pointing up.
editor.settingsHelp: In face widths (1 = the width of the face), from the anchor point. Test with “Open” on a computer with a webcam, adjust, repeat.
editor.testHelp: Scan the QR with the phone: the filter opens with the selfie camera.
editor.title: Create your face filter

player.subtitle: Allow the camera, then face the screen. Open your mouth, wink, raise your eyebrows: the scene can react.
player.title: A face filter

home.lead: Your Spline scenes in augmented reality, in the phone's browser, with a simple link: they come out of a poster, or you wear them on your face like a filter.
home.pageTitle: Spline AR — your 3D out of the frame
home.postersTitle: Show the posters to aim at
home.templatesHelp: Try them: open “Posters” on a computer and aim your phone at the screen, or start the filter in selfie mode. In AR, tap the 3D to interact. “Edit” makes your own copy.
home.title: Bring your 3D out of the frame
home.worksEmpty: Nothing yet. Your museums and filters will show up here as soon as you create their link.

editor.imageHelp: JPG or PNG, at least 480 × 640 px, rich in detail. Area used: the centre, in 3:4 format.
editor.importNone: No poster created here in this link.
editor.lead: One or more posters, each with its Spline scene. One link: the phone aiming at a poster sees its 3D come out.
editor.settingsHelp: In poster widths (1 = the full width). “Flat”: the scene stands above the image lying on a table; lift becomes height and rotation turns around the vertical axis. Changing a setting does not re-upload the poster.
editor.testHelp: To test: open “Show the posters” on the computer, scan the QR with the phone and aim at the screen.
editor.title: Create your AR museum
